title: Japanese Views Regarding The Informal Statement Made

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL
REPORT
S. 2, Special Branch.
Date ____ Apr ____ 1934

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No: S. B. REGISTRY. / 5860 / Date 4 / 1 / 34）

Subject (in full) Japanese views regarding the informal statement made by a
spokesman of the Japanese Foreign Office.

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by （签名） D./.

（左侧批注：X. Jap. Official view. Decline to discuss the matter. D.R.）

In accordance with the instructions of the Officer i/c
Special Branch, I have to state that the consensus of opinion
of the local Japanese community regarding the informal statement
made by a spokesman of the Foreign Office is that the statement
contains nothing but facts as to conditions in the Far East
and that the furore had been caused through misunderstanding
by foreign Powers of the real intentions of Japan. The issue
will probably be settled when the foreign Powers view the matter
in its true perspective.

The comments made by Japanese papers well represent the
views of the Japanese public who strongly support the policy
of the Japanese Government towards China as has been announced
in the statement.

I forward herewith a translation of comments made by the
"Shanghai Nippo" and the "Shanghai Mainichi".

（左侧批注：X / SD）

（签名） D. S. Umemoto.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
机密
报告
S. 2，特别分部。
日期 ____ 1934年4月 ____ 日

（印：上海公共租界工部局 / 档案号：S. B. REGISTRY. / 5860 / 日期 4 / 1 / 34）

主题（全称）日本方面关于日本外务省发言人非正式声明的看法。

由 D. S. Umemoto 撰写。转呈人 （签名） D./.

（左侧批注：X. 日本官方观点。拒绝讨论此事。D.R.）

遵照特别分部主管官员的指示，本人谨陈述如下：当地日本侨民界对于外务省发言人所作非正式声明的普遍看法是，该声明仅陈述了有关远东局势的事实，而由此引发的轩然大波是由于外国列强误解了日本的真实意图所致。一旦外国列强以正确的视角看待此事，这一问题可能会得到解决。

日本报纸的评论很好地代表了日本公众的观点，他们强烈支持日本政府在对华政策上通过该声明所宣布的方针。

现随函附上《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）和《上海每日新闻》（Shanghai Mainichi）评论的译文。

（左侧批注：X / SD）

（签名） D. S. Umemoto.
D. S.

特别分部主管官员。

page_data.en:
Shanghai Nippo, April 28, 1934.

The publication of an informal statement by the Foreign
Office regarding Japanese policy towards China has become the
topic of conversation throughout the world. Certain people
strained the meaning purposely to make use of it in their
propaganda against Japan. A section of Chinese have tried
to take the opportunity to submit the Sino-Japanese issue for
discussion before an international conference but their
efforts have ended in complete failure.

In view of the tendency by foreign Powers to prey upon
China under the pretext of assistance or co-operation, Japan
had simply issued a warning in consideration of her position.
It is obvious that Japan does not oppose the Open Door policy
and Equal Opportunity in China and there was no intention
to secure privileged treatment for herself. During the past
few years, instead of receiving privileged treatment Japan has
been faced with the policy of closed door. The Chinese
Government did not adopt any measures to suppress the illegal
anti-Japanese movement and boycott of Japanese goods saying
that they could not suppress the voluntary movements of the
masses. It is clear that the policy of the Chinese Government
has brought about unequal opportunity towards Japan. Japan
desires more than the foreign Powers for an Open Door policy
and Equal Opportunity.

If the assistance by the Powers and investment of foreign
capital in China can bring about prosperity, why should Japan
interfere. The informal statement contained nothing about
assistance and investment of capital by foreign Powers with
good intention.

Regarding the question of the Nine Power Treaty, Japan
has no intention to violate it. The fact has clearly been
explained in the second statement issued by the Foreign Office.
It is ridiculous for China to agitate for a meeting of the
page_data.zh:
《上海日报》，1934年4月28日。

外务省发表关于日本对华政策的非正式声明，已成为全世界谈论的话题。某些人故意曲解其含义，利用它进行反日宣传。部分中国人试图借此机会将中日问题提交国际会议讨论，但其努力最终以彻底失败告终。

鉴于外国列强倾向于以援助或合作为借口掠夺中国，日本只是出于自身立场考虑发出了警告。显而易见，日本并不反对在中国的“门户开放”政策和“机会均等”原则，也无意为自己谋取特权待遇。在过去几年中，日本非但没有获得特权待遇，反而面临着“关门”政策。中国政府未采取任何措施镇压非法的反日运动和抵制日货行为，声称他们无法压制民众的自愿运动。显然，中国政府的政策给日本带来了不平等的机会。日本比外国列强更渴望在中国的“门户开放”政策和“机会均等”原则。

如果列强的援助和外国资本在华投资能带来繁荣，日本何必干涉。该非正式声明中并未包含任何关于外国列强怀着善意提供援助和投资的内容。

关于《九国公约》问题，日本无意违反该条约。外务省发布的第二份声明已对此事实作了清楚说明。中国鼓动召开

nine treaty Powers to discuss the Far Eastern problem.
The informal statement made by Japan seems now to be
better understood by the Powers as their excitement has subsided.
------------------
Shanghai Mainichi, April 28, 1934.
The London Times of April 26 stated that Japan's
political and economical position in China should be recognized
and that it was a matter of course for Japan to demand the
leading position in the matter of international co-operation
in China. Japan, however, should co-operate with the foreign
Powers to attain this object instead of disputing with them.
The co-operation in China by the foreign Powers as indicated
by the Times, and Japan's co-operation based upon the maintenance
of peace in the Far East do not coincide. This difference in
the fundamental idea of co-operation should be clearly under-
stood by us. A certain person playing an important role in
the formulation of 'merican policy in the Far East holds the
view that the military development of China will be a guarantee
for the maintenance of peace in the Far East. This statement,
when closedly examined, reveals one of the erroneous ideas
expected from co-operation in China.
What has co-operation done for China? It has served
to induce war instead of preventing it and to intensify enmity
rather than to foster friendship, confidence and co-operation
for the prosperity and peace of the Orient. And all this has
been brought about by the Chinese policy of relying on others -
a policy which had originated from such co-operation. Co-
operation between China and Soviet Russia resulted in the
activities of the Chinese Communist Party and several provinces
have been devastated. The purpose of Japanese co-operation
page_data.zh:
( 2 )

九个缔约国会议以讨论远东问题，这是荒谬的。
目前，随着各方的激动情绪平息，列强似乎对日本所作的非正式声明有了更好的理解。
---
《上海每日新闻》，1934年4月28日。
4月26日的《泰晤士报》指出，应承认日本在中国的政治和经济地位，日本要求在国际合作对华事务中占据主导地位是理所当然的。然而，日本应与外国列强合作以实现这一目标，而不是与其争执。正如《泰晤士报》所指出的那样，外国列强在华的合作，与日本基于维护远东和平的合作并不一致。我们应该清楚地理解这种在合作基本理念上的差异。某位在制定美国远东政策中扮演重要角色的人士认为，中国的军事发展将是维护远东和平的保障。仔细审视这一言论，便揭示了人们对在华合作所抱有的错误观念之一。
合作为中国做了什么？它诱发了战争而非防止战争，加剧了敌意而非培育友谊、信任与合作，从而促进东方的繁荣与和平。而这一切都是由中国依赖他人的政策造成的——这一政策正是源于此类合作。中国与苏维埃俄国的合作导致了中国共产党活动的兴起，数个省份因此遭受破坏。日本合作的目的

page_data.en:
( 3 )
is entirely different from this selfish policy. For the
sake of peace in the Orient, Japan has clearly discerned
between the two kinds of co-operation in China and this should
be gratefully recognized by China.
--------------------------
Shanghai Nippo, April 27, 1934.
The erroneous impression created abroad by the recent
pronouncement has been modified and America and various European
nations are adopting a very careful attitude. They have recovered
from the excitement and are endeavouring to study the real
intentions and the position of Japan. The inquiry by the
British Government to the Japanese Foreign Minister was
considered mild, to the disappointment of a certain section
of Chinese. The United States, it is believed, will adopt
an attitude of moderation. All these Powers emphasize their
right to have a voice in matters relating to China and the
protection of their treaty rights. They are not adopting
a firm attitude owing to the fact that the informal statement
contained nothing but facts as to conditions in the Far East.
Certain Chinese have tried to make use of the opportunity
to secure the assistance of foreign Powers but their efforts
have ended in complete failure. The real intentions of Japan
have been clearly explained in the subsequent statement. Japan
does not intend to deviate from her policy of Open Door and
Equal Opportunity in China. It was a misunderstanding of
Japan's intentions that had caused the excitement. It is also
obvious that anti-Japanese agitation has been introduced to
suppress Japan's policy towards China. When the furore has
subsided, the foreign Powers will view the issue in its true
perspective. Japan's position will then be better understood.
It is useless to become indignant and make pessimistic statements
for they would only cause our nationals to be over-concerned
about the matter.
page_data.zh:
( 3 )
与这种自私的政策截然不同。为了东方的和平，日本已清楚地区分了在华两种不同类型的合作，对此中国应心存感激并予以认可。
---
《上海日报》，1934年4月27日。
近期声明在国外造成的错误印象已得到修正，美国和欧洲各国正采取非常谨慎的态度。他们已从激动情绪中恢复过来，并致力于研究日本的真实意图和立场。英国政府向日本外务大臣提出的询问被认为态度温和，这令部分中国人感到失望。据信，美国将采取温和的态度。所有这些列强都强调其在涉及中国事务及保护其条约权利方面拥有发言权。由于该非正式声明仅陈述了有关远东局势的事实，他们并未采取强硬态度。某些中国人试图利用此机会寻求外国列强的援助，但其努力最终以彻底失败告终。日本的真实意图在随后的声明中已得到清楚解释。日本无意偏离其在中国的“门户开放”和“机会均等”政策。正是对日本意图的误解引发了这场骚动。同样明显的是，反日煽动被引入以压制日本的对华政策。当喧嚣平息后，外国列强将以正确的视角看待这一问题。届时，日本的立场将得到更好的理解。愤怒和发表悲观言论是无用的，因为这只会导致我国国民对此事过度担忧。
